messages:
incident-bot: Pager alert: HIGH error-rate on /v1/generate (incidence_id=INC-2026-0423). Error spike detected 03:12 UTC -> 03:18 UTC. Auto-mitigations attempted: route-fallback to model-v1b, failed for some requests.

sarah_oncall: I'm on it, pulling dashboards + logs now.

raj_eng_sre: ack. Can you post top-line numbers (error rate, affected tenants, latency impact)?

sarah_oncall: quick numbers: 5xx rate peaked 3.2% (baseline ~0.02%). 14 orgs saw >1% errors, top impacted: acme-inc, blue-sys, partner-x. p50 latency +120ms, p95 +600ms.

emily_prod: acme reported 500s for their autocomplete flow. They're asking if we'll credit them — their contract has a 99.9% availability SLO.

michael_pm: if SLO breached for a customer we need to start credit estimate and postmortem. Severity: SLO breach -> classify as Sev2 (customer visible, partial degradation).

sarah_oncall: mitigation: rolled routing policy back to primary route and forced model-variant stable-v1. Error rate dropped to 0.12% in 6m after rollback. No ongoing outages.

raj_eng_sre: good. Save current KV cache state + logs. Run trace extraction for the 03:10-03:20 window:```
# quick capture
curl -s "https://internal-metrics/api/trace?from=2834999800&to=2835000200" -H "Authorization: Bearer $INC_TOKEN" > /tmp/inc-2835-traces.json
```

emily_prod: I'll open a customer-facing ticket and prep comms. Propose offering 5% credit for affected window to acme and 3% to others (TBD after final calculation).

michael_pm: please don't finalize credits until billing confirms. Add credit estimate as an action item on the postmortem.

raj_eng_sre: root cause hypothesis: model routing fallback incorrectly matched a model variant missing a required tokenizer patch; some requests hit a codepath that caused 5xx. Need fix in router and add unit test.

sarah_oncall: scheduling: propose postmortem tomorrow 10:00 PT (calendar link: https://calendar.redwood.com/postmortems/INC-2026-0423). Can everyone make it?

emily_prod: +1 for 10am. I'll own comms.

raj_eng_sre: I'll own the technical write-up and the remediation fix. Estimate sizing: routing fix + tests = 3d (medium). Add KV cache validation + monitors = 2d (small).

michael_pm: add action item to prioritize routing fix into Q3 reliability sprint. Impacted customers -> treat as P1 for capacity allocation.

emily_prod: action items suggestion list (with estimates):
- RED-5891: Root cause doc + timeline (owner: raj_eng_sre) — estimate: 1d
- RED-5892: Routing router patch + unit tests (owner: raj_eng_sre) — estimate: 3d
- RED-5893: Add KV cache integrity checks + alerting (owner: sarah_oncall) — estimate: 2d
- RED-5894: Customer comms + credit calc (owner: emily_prod) — estimate: 1d to finalize credit amounts with finance
- RED-5895: Add synthetic test that simulates model-variant mismatch (owner: eng-qa) — estimate: 4d

raj_eng_sre: created RED-5891, RED-5892, RED-5893 in tracker. Linking: https://tracker.redwood.com/RED-5892

sarah_oncall: prioritization matrix: because this triggered SLO breach and multiple customers affected, mark RED-5892 as P0 for the sprint intake board. Tie into Q3 reliability sprint as requested.

michael_pm: we'll reserve 2 engineer-weeks in Q3 sprint buffer for this family of fixes. Finance: @billing-team please watch for credit request from emily_prod (will post final numbers after postmortem).

emily_prod: noted — I'll post the credit estimate in RED-5894 by EOD.

raj_eng_sre: cleanup tasks: preserve logs, attach sampled traces to RED-5891, and add a regression alert: trigger when model-variant fallback rate > 0.5% of total requests for 5m.

sarah_oncall: final summary: incident auto-detected, rolled back routing -> mitigated. SLO impact observed (peak 3.2% 5xx), ~14 customers saw elevated errors. Postmortem scheduled 10:00 PT tomorrow. Action items created (RED-5891..5895) with owners and rough sizing. RED-5892 set to P0 / Q3 reliability tie-in.

incident-bot: Postmortem created and invite sent to participants. Reminder set 24h before. :calendar: :white_check_mark:

michael_pm: thanks team — please update your tickets with final estimates before the postmortem so we can lock sprint scope.

sarah_oncall: will update RED-5893 with logs and the mitigation timeline now.

emily_prod: drafting comms and credit estimate, will ping billing.

raj_eng_sre: starting on RED-5892 branch, will post a PR link in tracker when ready.

sarah_oncall: closing thread for now — will reconvene in postmortem. :lock:
